description: Return the verified saved report for a completed Grade this account owns, by jobId. Returns unavailable until the saved report is readable; never grades again. headline carries the saved coarse letter and, for newer Grades, letterFine; show letterFine when present, otherwise letter. rockySummary carries each leg’s modeled win chance against its break-even and its EV, the chance all legs win, confidence, top risks and the NG reasons (chances and EV as fractions), and view: Research and Price, each a level (Strong, OK or Weak, or null when it couldn’t be checked) with a plain reason; what moved the Grade, by name; on Grades saved before 2026-11-05, the cap line when a better price capped the letter; and the checks that couldn’t run. The same breakdown the app shows. On Grades made under the one-number rule, rockySummary.oneNumber says where the letter started (startLetter; each leg’s start chance and whether it is the Desk’s number or the same-line price) and lists the evidence that moved it: what happened, helps or hurts, how many points of chance, the source link and the exact sentence quoted from it; line is the biggest item as one sentence, or, when nothing moved the letter, a quoted context sentence that says it is context and claims no points (else null). Show the saved result in an interactive BSD card in the chat. Use this tool when the customer wants to see their saved result. This is a read-only view.
name: show_saved_grade
title: Show saved Grade card
